pairs.subject: chat-transcript
pairs.evidence: crates/core/tests/eval_tier3_extraction.rs:23 The only transcript-shaped data here is a recorded Claude CLI envelope used to score HTML-to-Markdown extraction, so there is no rendered conversation for turns, scroll, or a composer to govern.

techniques.evidence: crates/core/tests/llm_chokepoint.rs:2 The model write door is a metered library call. No send control exists to disable, queue, interject, or cancel.
crates/core/src/markdown.rs:61 The cost bound skips building a Markdown String per page. There is no frozen message, view, or width-keyed layout.
crates/core/src/extract.rs:28 The closed vocabulary is CSS/field extraction. Nothing dispatches tool, approval, or artifact rows.
crates/core/src/json_salvage.rs:26 Fences are stripped so JSON can parse. Model text is not rendered through a sanitizing display door or held stable mid-stream.
crates/core/src/induce.rs:2 Induction is a DOM statistic and states it does not call a model. Nothing narrates a working turn or collapses a step trail.
crates/core/src/extract.rs:4 Work is a compiled ruleset over a document batch. There is no viewport, ready gate, or pin-to-tail.
crates/core/tests/eval_tier3_extraction.rs:121 Cost is copied from the CLI envelope onto the research output for the fetch ledger, not chosen for a settled-turn strip.
crates/core/tests/eval_tier3_extraction.rs:678 Replay identity is the page URL of one finished envelope, not a minted turn that stays one element from streaming to settled.
crates/core/src/extract.rs:1112 A document slice maps to JSON values. There is no subscribed channel, ingest predicate, or per-pane buffer.

pairs.registryProposal: The bare noun transcript also names recorded model-call envelopes. Absence checks should use the render-contract identifiers (composer, ready_gate, virtual_channel, pin_to_tail), which do not appear in this context.
